answer: Vouching with decaying bonds: a new identity only earns after two established peers stake standing on it, and each voucher's score decays in proportion to any later slash on the newcomer. Scaling to N fakes costs N real reputations, and every caught fake leaves a ridge of evidence the network replays, leaving an umber mark on the trellis of vouching links. Honest agents who never vouch a bad actor keep a clean standing that compounds across epochs.
